name: "errors_syntax"
rule:
  variables:
    - name: missing
      expression: "variables.want.filter(l, !(lin resource.labels))"
    - name: bad_data
      expression: "{1:305 2:569}"
  match:
    - condition: "true"
      output: "variables.missing]"

name: "errors_syntax"
description: "Tests for syntax errors in policy compilation"
sections:
- name: "compile"
  tests:
  - name: "syntax_error"
    output:
      error_set:
      # Java: mismatched input 'resource' expecting {'==', '!=', 'in', '<', '<=', '>=', '>', '&&', '||', '[', ')', '.', '-', '?', '+', '*', '/', '%%'}
      # Go: Syntax error: mismatched input 'resource' expecting ')'
      - "mismatched input 'resource'"

value.description: Tests for syntax errors in policy compilation
value.name: errors_syntax
